test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

The oil in the diya symbolises the dirt in the human mind such as greed, ________, hate, etc.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Envy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option is: **envy**
 
• **In this context,** the oil in the diya (lamp) is being compared to negative traits in the human mind.
 
• The word** "envy"** fits best because it is a negative trait, just like greed and hate.
